outcome: Type of anesthesia used for cesarean delivery (general, spinal, epidural)
cohort: 300 women undergoing category 2 and 3 cesarean deliveries
finding: The type of labor analgesia used was significantly associated with the type of anesthesia used for cesarean delivery, with remifentanil-PCA being associated with a higher likelihood of general anesthesia.
mod_finding: This study found that the type of labor analgesia used was associated with the type of anesthesia used for categories 2 and 3 cesarean deliveries.
